Qdrant — vector database

qdrant/cloud · version 1

envs add qdrant/cloud

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
QDRANT_URL required config Your cluster, including its port. An address.. where to get it
QDRANT_API_KEY required secret Shown once, and Qdrant says TLS is required so it does not leak over an unencrypted connection. A read-only key is still secret: read-only is not public. Self-hosted reads QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY instead, which is the documented name there.. where to get it
